[P2] Return to design for skipped-branch lifecycle coverage

Rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it,” is not satisfied for these skipped-branch plugin paths. The new virtual-child unit test completes successfully without a plugin, and the new integration cases use default NESTED branches. Removing this terminal-hook call or its success counterpart changes no assertion, leaving the lifecycle regression unprotected. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and establish regression coverage that requires the terminal hook for both successful and failing skipped FLAT branches.
